evals.prompt: Restructure a disorganized CLI tool README according to the Inverted Pyramid model.
evals.expected_output: A refactored README with Title & Summary, Prescribed Quickstart Action above the fold, Usage Guide, Developer Instructions, Architecture, and License.
assertions: Places installation command and quickstart action above the fold
Presents Usage Guide and CLI flags table before internal architecture
Pushes build instructions and testing to Developer section
Positions License and legal compliance at the bottom

evals.prompt: Audit an engineering blog post draft that starts with 3 paragraphs of historical background before introducing the problem.
evals.expected_output: An audit report recommending moving the core thesis and working example to the top 150 words.
assertions: Flags buried lead / delayed core thesis
Recommends Inverted Pyramid lead block in first 150 words
Recommends providing a working code snippet or diagram early
